note: P differs in vessel silhouette (tall pillar, bulbous, classic bottle, tapered with panel), palette (violet/pink, ember, orange, violet/amber) and control layout; Q varies metals, liquid colours and control placement (brass with switch, copper maroon, chrome with bottom bar, bell cap) but shares the tapered cone; R is one design repeated (tapered cone, chrome/brass, right-hand panel, dark background), and R4 is pixelated with wax that barely moves and almost no visible glass, so it weakly breaks the moving-blobs requirement.
